profile.reading: Per Simple Helix own site, this Huntsville, Alabama facility sits at 165 West Park Loop NW and is built to Tier III specification with 2N plus 1 power and cooling redundancy. The page states 4.5 MW of utility power, 4.5 MW of generator capacity, and 4.5 MW of UPS power capacity; because all three independent power path figures agree at 4.5 MW, this is adopted here as the facilitys critical_it_mw. On site fuel storage totals 16,000 gallons with fuel scrubbers, and the site sits outside the 100 year flood plain. Compliance includes DFARS 252.204-7012, NIST 800-171a, SOC2 Type 2, and PCI, with CMMC v2.0 tracking underway.

reading.body:
SimpleHelix's Huntsville facility provides 4.5 MW of critical IT capacity with tripled power paths, placing it among small regional data centers oriented toward compliance-heavy workloads rather than hyperscale AI training.

The facility's power architecture reveals its design purpose. Utility power, generator capacity, and UPS capacity all match at 4.5 MW, with 2N plus 1 redundancy across all three. This symmetry is uncommon in larger centers and indicates a facility built for continuous availability to applications that cannot tolerate outages, not for maximum compute density. The 16,000 gallon on-site fuel storage supports multi-day runtime in grid failures.

The compliance footprint is dense relative to capacity. DFARS, NIST 800-171a, SOC2 Type 2, and PCI certifications, with CMMC v2.0 underway, suggest the facility primarily serves federal contractors, defense supply chain entities, and regulated financial services rather than frontier AI labs. These workloads are compute-constrained by security and sovereignty requirements, not by power availability.

For AI scaling, this facility represents the opposite binding constraint from the public cloud hyperscalers. It is not power-limited; it is compliance-constrained. It does not reveal whether Huntsville itself has grid capacity to support additional data center buildout, nor does it address the broader Alabama power supply picture for industrial load.
